hero_title: A Brand You'll Actually Be Proud To Show People.
hero_lead: Hi, I'm Usama — I design logos and brand identities for business owners who are ready to stop apologizing for their old logo. No jargon, no confusing back-and-forth, just clear communication and a brand that feels like you, worldwide.
about_title: Hi, I'm Usama — Nice To Meet You.
about_paragraph_1: I've been designing logos and brand identities for 7 years now, and I still enjoy the moment a client sees their new logo for the first time. Kroma Vance is just me — no big team, no account managers passing your project around — which means you get my full attention from the first message to the final file.
about_paragraph_2: I keep things simple: you tell me about your business, I ask a few honest questions, and we figure out a brand that actually fits. If you're easy to talk to, I'm easy to work with.
footer_tagline: Logo and brand identity design by Usama Ramzan — for ambitious people, wherever they're building.
